AI Application Development

Work with the Data Scientist and cross-functional teams to develop AI-enabled applications and services, including working closely with data engineering and Digital and Technology teams.
Develop user-facing and backend components using appropriate technologies, including Microsoft Power Apps where suitable and Python or JavaScript-based services where pro-code is required.
Use Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning and other Azure AI services to build and integrate AI capabilities.
Build, test and evaluate AI and generative AI components, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic or vector search and agent-based patterns where appropriate.

Application Deployment And Support

Deploy AI applications and models to internal customers, ensuring effective integration, reliability, security and functionality.
Monitor and troubleshoot developed applications and services, resolving faults and supporting continuous improvement.
Apply British Council requirements for information security, data protection, accessibility and responsible AI, including appropriate testing and controls for AI-specific risks.

Agile Development

Work in an agile development environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own defined work packages, prioritise tasks with the team and deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

Support the development of customer-centric and insight-led working.
Collaborate with team members, stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand user and business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly.

Leadership and management (self-development)

Complete British Council induction, mandatory training and role-related learning.
Keep technical knowledge current across AI, software engineering and cloud technologies, applying learning to practical delivery.
Seek feedback and mentoring, contribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing, and take responsibility for continuous professional development

Minimum/essential

Requirements of the role

Degree-level qualification or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline.
Applied AI engineering. Practical experience, gained through employment, internship, academic work or substantial projects, of building AI or machine learning applications.
Programming and software engineering. Proficiency in Python and experience with APIs, JSON, Git/version control and testing. Familiarity with SQL and software development practices.
Generative AI and machine learning. Practical understanding of large language models and common patterns such as prompt engineering, embeddings or vector search, RAG and agentic workflows, plus familiarity with at least one machine learning or AI framework or SDK.
Cloud and deployment. Practical exposure to Azure or another major cloud platform for developing or deploying applications, with an understanding of CI/CD, containers and monitoring concepts.
Responsible delivery and collaboration. Understanding of information security, data protection and responsible AI risks, and the ability to work in an agile, multidisciplinary team and communicate technical issues clearly

Desirable

Microsoft AI stack. Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning or related Azure AI services.
AI engineering tools. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and with vector databases or semantic search.
Full-stack delivery. Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, REST APIs and frontend or low-code development such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Microsoft Power Apps.

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We are looking for a Power Platform Product Specialist to raise the technical bar within our Portfolio team. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who builds high-quality solutions across D365 Sales, D365 Customer Service and the wider Power Platform, and who wants to help elevate what our function can deliver.

You will sit at the centre of a clear delivery model. Our Delivery Analyst shapes well-defined work with clear acceptance criteria; our Microsoft Platform Engineer sets the architecture, standards and technical direction; and you turn that into robust, scalable and supportable solutions. You will work closely with the Engineer as their technical counterpart, sharing ownership of build quality and pushing our engineering standards forward.

You will automate the manual, integrate the disconnected, and use AI to work smarter. If you enjoy solving real problems for real people and take pride in solutions that last, this is a chance to make a visible difference across the firm.

We are open to considering applications for our offices in London, Cardiff and/or Manchester.

Key Responsibilities

Build

Design, develop and support solutions using Power Automate, D365 Sales, D365 Customer Service and the wider Power Platform.
Deliver technical customisation and extension work; automations, integrations and configuration that meet real business needs.
Build to agreed engineering standards; environments, ALM, security and integration patterns set with the D365 Engineer.
Write solutions that are scalable, maintainable and well-documented, not just quick to ship.
Contribute to peer reviews and help lift the technical quality of everything the team produces.

Support and Improve

Support and continuously improve our existing D365 and Power Platform solutions.
Investigate issues, find the root cause and deliver permanent fixes rather than workarounds.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve the experience for our users.
Maintain clear, current technical documentation and solution artefacts.

Collaborate and communicate

Work closely with the Delivery Analyst to turn well-shaped stories into working software.
Partner with the D365 Engineer to keep solutions aligned to architecture, standards and best practice.
Engage business stakeholders directly to understand the problem before building the solution.
Work effectively with our Microsoft delivery partner and other suppliers where needed.
Share what you know and help the wider firm get more from the Microsoft platform.

About you

You are a curious, hands-on builder who enjoys shipping useful things and improving them. You take pride in leaving something better than you found it, and you know the best solutions come from good engineering, good listening and good judgement.

Essential experience required

Strong, hands-on experience building with Power Automate.
Solid experience configuring and supporting D365 Sales.
Solid experience configuring and supporting D365 Customer Service.
A track record of building real, technical solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, and the drive to fix things properly.
Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A genuine interest in AI and using it to work more efficiently; for example, accelerating user story creation, test case generation, documentation and analysis.

Preferred experience

Power Apps (canvas and model-driven).
Power Pages.
JavaScript, APIs, plug-ins, custom integrations or other pro-code Power Platform development.
Azure DevOps (ADO).
Experience of agile delivery.

Desired experience, however, not essential

Application Lifecycle Management (ALM).
SharePoint.
Copilot Studio or AI Builder.
Experience in a legal or professional services environment.

Certifications

Microsoft certifications are desirable but not essential. You do not need to hold all of them, and we welcome applications from candidates who are actively studying towards them. Relevant examples include PL-900, PL-200, PL-400, MB-210 (D365 Sales) and MB-230 (D365 Customer Service).

At Lewis Silkin our ethos is simple. We strive to do the best for our clients, our people and the communities in which we operate. We recognise that an inclusive workplace allows for all kinds of ideas and thoughts, a variety of points of view that can trigger discussions or deliver innovative results, and a wide range of versatile skills and expertise. We are proud of the diversity within Lewis Silkin and of our culture that allows people to be themselves at work, ensuring we provide the best possible service to our clients. We are committed to supporting candidates throughout the recruitment process by supporting anyone who requires adjustments, in order to ensure they have the opportunity to perform at their best. All applicants will be considered equally and fairly. If you’d like to request any adjustments throughout the recruitment process, or would like to discuss flexible working patterns, please email the recruitment team in confidence ( recruitment@lewissilkin.com ).

jobs.description:
About the team:

We are recruiting a Quality Engineering Manager (Data)
to lead and evolve the quality engineering capability across OSB Group's data platforms, pipelines and reporting solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role, combining people leadership with deep technical involvement across multiple strategic data programmes. You'll lead a team of up to 20 Quality Engineers across the UK and India whilst remaining close to delivery, shaping quality engineering practices, driving automation, and providing technical leadership across our Azure-based data estate.

Working within the Quality Engineering Chapter, you'll partner closely with Data Engineering, Architecture and Product teams to ensure robust, scalable and secure data solutions are delivered with quality embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

This role can be based from our Chatham or Wolverhampton offices and works within our hybrid policy of 3 days in the office.

What you will be doing:

As Quality Engineering Manager (Data)
, you will provide leadership across multiple concurrent programmes and transformation initiatives, whilst remaining actively involved in the design and implementation of modern quality engineering practices. You will champion quality across the entire data ecosystem, leveraging automation, cloud-native tooling and AI-enabled capabilities to improve efficiency, data reliability and speed of delivery.

Key responsibilities will include…
Provide hands-on technical leadership across multiple data and transformation programmes, supporting delivery from design through to production.
Define and embed quality engineering standards, frameworks and best practices across OSB Group's Azure-based data platforms.
Drive test automation and AI-enabled quality engineering approaches to improve efficiency, coverage and speed of delivery.
Design, review and execute testing for complex ETL pipelines, data warehouses, reporting solutions and analytics platforms.
Validate data solutions across Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks and SQL Server, ensuring accuracy, integrity and reliability.
Support quality assurance for large-scale data migration and modernisation programmes, including reconciliation, validation and defect management.
Partner closely with engineers, architects and business stakeholders to manage quality risks, improve outcomes and deliver trusted data solutions.

What's in it for you?

Base salary of between £65,000-£71,000
Enhanced family-focused benefits
Annual bonus opportunity
28 days annual leave + bank holidays

Please use this link to see the fantastic benefits available at OSB: https://www.osb.co.uk/careers/overview

About Us

At OSB Group, we understand how much our people bring to our organisation, which is why we try our best to give back too! Our Purpose is to help our customers, colleagues and communities prosper and we are on a transformation journey to become 'the bank of the future'.
Our commitment to professional development, flexible working, and employee well-being fosters a dynamic and supportive workplace.

Do you have the skills?

We're looking for someone who enjoys working collaboratively in Agile teams and translating business needs into solutions that deliver real value.

You'll ideally have:
Proven experience leading and developing high-performing Quality Engineering, Test or QA teams within data-centric environments, including large distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations
Strong hands-on experience across data testing, ETL validation, reconciliation, data quality engineering and large-scale data migration or transformation programmes.
Deep knowledge of Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks and SQL Server, with advanced SQL skills for validating complex datasets.
Experience developing automated testing and quality engineering solutions using tools such as Python, dbt, Great Expectations or similar frameworks.
Understanding of modern Agile, DevOps and CI/CD practices, including the use of AI-assisted testing and engineering tools.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences whilst managing multiple priorities and programmes.

Next steps:

If this sounds like you, apply now! Still on the fence? Hear from our team or explore our process: OSB Careers

Shortlisted candidates will go through a personalised recruitment process that is relevant, conversational and inclusive of any reasonable support required. We want to bring out the best in you.

Diversity & Inclusion

We champion diversity at all levels, with Board-level Diversity Champions tracking our progress. We are proud to be signed up to the Women in Finance Charter to actively support the growth and development of senior women in our sector and are dedicated to treating all our employees and job applicants equally, opposed to discrimination on any grounds.

jobs.title: Engineering, Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.
Comfortable splitting time between hands-on ticket testing and automation work, rather than being purely one or the other.

Ways of Working

Genuinely hybrid: as comfortable manually testing a ticket as contributing to an automation framework.
Collaborative: complements and supports the existing QA lead's automation strategy rather than working around it.
Pragmatic about what to automate first, while making sure day-to-day coverage across Salesforce and Web doesn't slip in the meantime.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

jobs.title: Systems Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Brightwell is a leading organization dedicated to delivering innovative pension administration solutions and financial services. Renowned for its commitment to excellence, integrity, and customer-centric approach, Brightwell serves a diverse client base across various sectors. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, where technological innovation and professional growth are prioritized. With a focus on continuous improvement and sustainable development, Brightwell strives to provide its employees with opportunities to excel and make meaningful contributions to the industry.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Systems Developer to join our Member Services team at Brightwell. This pivotal role involves the configuration, support, and ongoing development of the IntelliPen Pensions Administration platform, a core system that underpins our operational excellence. Reporting directly to the Senior System Development Manager, the successful candidate will work closely with internal teams, third-party partners, and stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, implement innovative solutions, and ensure the platform aligns with business needs and compliance standards.

The Senior Systems Developer will play a key role in driving continuous improvement initiatives, supporting system integrations, and ensuring high-quality releases. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a technically proficient professional to contribute to a forward-thinking organization that values innovation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in supporting and developing defined benefit pensions administration systems, with proven experience in delivering technology enhancements that improve operational efficiency and member outcomes. Essential qualifications include a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, along with extensive hands-on experience in system configuration, development, and support within a pensions or financial services environment.

Advanced SQL skills are required, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries. Familiarity with IntelliPen or similar pension administration platforms is highly desirable. The candidate should demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a disciplined approach to change management, requirements gathering, testing, and deployment. Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential for influencing stakeholders and providing technical leadership.

Responsibilities

Support the design, development, and enhancement of IntelliPen platform functionalities, including workflows, reporting, document generation, member portals, calculations, and system integrations.
Provide expert technical support to development teams and operational staff, resolving day-to-day incidents and complex system issues promptly and effectively.
Collaborate with internal change management and project teams, as well as third-party partners, to deliver system improvements that enhance the overall member experience.
Work alongside the QA Lead to define and execute testing strategies, ensuring the reliability and quality of system releases.
Partner with the Senior Service & Support Administrator and Development Manager to plan development roadmaps, manage sprint activities, and support a continuous delivery environment.
Produce and analyze development reports to demonstrate the impact and value of enhancements across the platform, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Ensure all development activities comply with regulatory standards and governance requirements, maintaining system integrity and security.
Take ownership of solution design and implementation, providing technical mentorship to colleagues and fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

Benefits

Brightwell offers a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefits scheme designed to support our employees' well-being and professional growth. Benefits include an annual performance bonus, 25 days of holiday entitlement (which increases to 30 days with service) plus bank holidays, and a pension scheme with employer contributions ranging from 15% to 17% based on age.

Additional perks encompass 8 times salary life insurance, generous family-friendly policies such as up to 26 weeks of full-pay maternity, adoption, and paternity leave, as well as access to free health assessments, a health cash plan, professional development support, and an Employee Assistance Programme. Employees also benefit from the Wellhub wellness platform, promoting a healthy work-life balance and overall well-being.

Equal Opportunity

Brightwell is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees are valued and respected. We promote fair treatment, equal access to development opportunities, and a culture that celebrates differences. Our policies and practices are designed to ensure an equitable environment where everyone can thrive, contribute, and succeed. We believe that diversity enhances our innovation, performance, and community, and we actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds to join our team.

Head of Engineering – Financial Services | £150,000 + Bonus + Benefits | Paddington, London – 4 Days Office

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.
• Provide technical leadership across architecture, software development, data platforms, testing and system integration.
• Work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Oversee the development of applications, APIs, microservices and data platforms supporting financial services and trading.
• Establish and maintain strong engineering standards around code quality, testing, deployment and documentation.
• Drive the adoption of modern development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, cloud technologies and DevOps.
• Ensure close collaboration between developers, data engineers and QA throughout the development lifecycle.
• Help shape the long-term architecture and technology roadmap as the organisation continues its modernisation programme.
• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.

implementing automated data validation, anomaly detection, and proactive issue resolution
working with engineers, analysts, and AI/ML teams to align architecture with business needs
maintaining comprehensive architecture documentation and mentoring engineers

fluency in English

deep knowledge of Databricks (primary tool), Delta Lake, Apache Spark

proficiency with Data Factory, ADLS, Synapse, Azure SQL, Event Hubs
experience with CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes/AKS, Docker
ability to define strategy, mentor engineers, and drive adoption of best practices
great ability to create and maintain clear architectural documentation

We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.

Key responsibilities

Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack

About you

You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.

We're looking for someone who has:

A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
At least 4 years of professional software development experience
Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

High value if you also bring:

Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)

About Zendr

Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.

What we offer

Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
Work with a modern tech stack
High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth

Our hiring process

We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
Application review:
We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
First conversation:
An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
Coding assignment:
A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
Technical interview:
We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
Final meeting:
Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.

From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

Additional information

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
Start date:
As soon as possible
Scope:
Full-time, permanent position
Location:
Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

jobs.title: Solutions Architect - Nordics Fungible
jobs.description:
Req ID: FEQ327R409

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to haves

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.
Depth in an industry vertical (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, and others).

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hej 3D Platform Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.

We’re Looking For a 3D Platform Engineer To Build The Shared Capabilities Behind IKEA’s Next Generation Of 3D Digital Planning And Product Experiences. You Will Transform Complex CAD And PLM Product Data Into Reliable, Scalable 3D Assets And Services—covering Tessellation, Mesh Optimization, LOD Generation, And Preservation Of Visual And Geometric Fidelity. Your Work Will Make High-quality 3D Product Data Easier To Use Across Customer-facing Planning Solutions, Content Production, And Product Development. On a Typical Week, You Will

Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C++, and Python.
Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well-defined development briefs.
Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
Collaborate in agile and DevOps teams across product and engineering areas to integrate shared 3D capabilities into planning, content, and product-development workflows, with clear communication and shared delivery commitments.
Provide technical direction for core 3D solutions, guide consumers in using platform capabilities and good practices, and collaborate effectively with internal teams, technology partners, and suppliers.
Build automated CAD-to-mesh pipelines that preserve product structure, metadata, geometry, materials, and instancing from PLM and CAD sources.
Develop and validate mesh-processing workflows for repair, tessellation, simplification, LOD generation, and delivery of high-fidelity and optimized asset variants.
Benchmark and integrate commercial and open-source technologies, building integration layers around CAD and geometry SDKs that enable scalable cloud-based 3D processing services.

Qualifications

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a 3D Platform Engineer, You Combine Strong Software Engineering With Practical Knowledge Of 3D Data, Pipelines, And Runtime Needs. You Can Work Across The Full Flow—from CAD And PLM Sources To Optimized Assets And Scalable Services. You Should Also Bring

A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.
Understanding of asset creation, materials, texturing, lighting, rigging, and scene composition; experience with OpenUSD, MaterialX, or glTF is a plus.
A platform and DevOps mindset, with experience building, operating, and improving business-critical services in an agile environment.
A degree in computer science, media technology, digital media, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.

Our technology landscape includes Azure, Terraform, Docker, OpenAPI, Three.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Python, MongoDB, Neo4j, PLM platforms, CAD and geometry SDKs, and mesh-processing libraries. You do not need to know them all- curiosity and a willingness to learn matter just as much.

It’s a Plus If You Also Bring

Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.
Experience with mesh-processing or optimization libraries and open 3D formats such as OpenUSD or glTF.

Additional Information

Be yourself, a 3D Platform Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 15th of October.

This is a full-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com If you have questions about the position, please contact the hiring manager taco.van.der.maden1@inter.ikea.com.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.description:
Om Hydro Building Systems

Hydro Building Systems Sweden AB utvecklar och marknadsför system i aluminiumprofiler till tre affärsområden: Transportsystem, Golvsystem och Byggsystem. Företaget marknadsför två starka varumärken, Sapa och WICONA, och är marknadsledande i Norden med en omsättning på cirka 750 miljoner kronor. Vi är cirka 120 medarbetare och är verksamma med försäljningskontor i hela Norden och Baltikum.

Vi ingår i den globala Hydro-koncernen, ett helintegrerat aluminiumkonsortium med 31 000 anställda i 40 länder på alla kontinenter, vilket kombinerar lokal kompetens, världsomfattande räckvidd och oöverträffad kompetens inom FoU. Utöver produktion av primäraluminium, valsade och strängpressade produkter och återvinning utvinner Hydro också bauxit, förädlar aluminiumoxid och genererar energi som det enda 360°-företaget i den globala aluminiumindustrin.

”Här har du möjlighet att skapa vår historia med din personlighet, kunskap, ambition och arbete i en global organisation på cykelavstånd där vi sätter medarbetaren i fokus! Vi agerar utifrån våra värdeord Care, Courage och Collaboration – Omtanke, Mod och Samarbete – och har stort fokus på hållbarhet, både gällande våra produkter och socialt. På Hydro Building Systems i Vetlanda är vi medarbetare med blandade roller som tillsammans bidrar till en dynamisk, utvecklande och inspirerande arbetsmiljö.”

Om tjänsten

I rollen arbetar du med support, testning och installation av de programvaror som används för ritning, kalkylering och produktionsberedning av våra byggsystem. Våra lösningar används i projekt som omfattar allt från enskilda dörrar och fönster till avancerade glasfasader och glastak.
Du blir en del av ett erfaret team där du arbetar nära både kunder, kollegor och utvecklingsorganisationen för att säkerställa hög kvalitet och bästa möjliga användarupplevelse.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Ge support till kunder och interna användare via telefon, e-post och digitala möten.
Felsöka och lösa problem relaterade till våra programvaror och installationer.
Testa och validera nya programversioner och uppdateringar.
Installera och uppdatera programvara hos kunder och internt.
Dokumentera och rapportera programfel och förbättringsförslag.
Bidra till planering och genomförande av större programuppdateringar.
Delta i kundutbildningar, kundmöten och andra aktiviteter vid behov.
Resor inom och utanför Sverige kan förekomma.

Din profil
Vi söker dig som:
Har teknisk utbildning på minst gymnasienivå eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
Har ett stort intresse för IT och teknik.
Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Trivs med att lösa problem och ge service till kunder.
Arbetar strukturerat och kan hantera flera ärenden parallellt.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
Teknisk support eller kundsupport.
CAD-program.
CNC, produktionsberedning eller tillverkningsindustri.
Byggsystem, aluminiumprofiler eller konstruktion av dörrar, fönster och fasader.

Som person

Du är serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du tycker om att hjälpa andra, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor. Noggrannhet, initiativförmåga och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt är viktiga egenskaper i rollen

Övrig information:

Tjänsten är placerad i Vetlanda.
Poolia ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen. Vid frågor, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Halima Iman Barre på halima.iman.barre@poolia.se.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval, vilket innebär att vi går igenom ansökningarna efter hand som de kommer in. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan redan idag!

Varmt välkommen till ett företag med höga ambitioner och en trevlig, öppen och samarbetsvänlig atmosfär!

jobs.title: QA Engineering Leader  | Range Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a Typical Day, You Will

Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.
Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.
Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.
Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.
Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.
Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.
Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.
Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.
Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.
Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

Qualifications

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey. 

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.  

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.
Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.
Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.

jobs.description:
As of 2 September 2025, Vivicta, former Tietoevry Tech Services, now operates as a standalone company under our new brand. We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at https://www.vivicta.com

Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.

Ratkaisuarkkitehti vastaa liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin sopivien teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja määrittelystä Microsoft Power Platform-, Azure- ja tekoälyympäristöissä. Hän varmistaa, että ratkaisut muodostavat toimivan, turvallisen ja ylläpidettävän kokonaisuuden, joka tukee organisaation tavoitteita sekä nykyisiä että tulevia tarpeita.

Roolissa yhdistyvät tekninen osaaminen, kokonaisuuksien hahmottaminen ja kyky tehdä yhteistyötä niin liiketoiminnan kuin teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Ratkaisuarkkitehti toimii siltana liiketoiminnan tavoitteiden ja käytännön toteutuksen välillä.

Etsimme ratkaisuarkkitehtia, joka pystyy yhdistämään liiketoiminnan tavoitteet, teknologian mahdollisuudet ja toteutuksen käytännön vaatimukset toimivaksi kokonaisuudeksi. Henkilöllä on kokemusta laajojen sovellus- ja integraatioratkaisujen suunnittelusta sekä kyky ohjata kehitystä arkkitehtuurin näkökulmasta koko ratkaisun elinkaaren ajan.

Menestyt roolissa, jos hahmotat kokonaisuuksia nopeasti, osaat tehdä perusteltuja teknisiä valintoja ja pystyt viestimään ne selkeästi sekä kehittäjille että liiketoiminnan edustajille. Lisäksi ymmärrät, miten pilvipalvelut, automaatio ja tekoäly voidaan yhdistää hallituksi ja liiketoimintaa tukevaksi ratkaisuksi.

Keskeiset tehtävät

Suunnitella liiketoiminnan tarpeita tukevia sovellus-, integraatio- ja tekoälyratkaisuja.
Määritellä ratkaisun rakenne, keskeiset komponentit, tietovirrat ja eri järjestelmien väliset riippuvuudet.
Vastata ratkaisujen hallittavuuteen, tietoturvaan, suorituskykyyn ja muihin ei-toiminnallisiin vaatimuksiin liittyvistä linjauksista.
Ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa ja tukea toteutuksen onnistumista koko projektin ajan.
Määritellä sovelluskehityksen hallintamalleja, ympäristöstrategioita sekä käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitokäytäntöjä.
Arvioida ja suunnitella tekoälyn hyödyntämistä osana liiketoimintaprosesseja ja digitaalisia palveluja.
Kuvata ja esitellä ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja eri sidosryhmille ymmärrettävästi.

Osaamisvaatimukset

Kokemusta Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen ja pilvipalveluiden arkkitehtuurisuunnittelusta.
Ymmärrys sovelluskehityksen elinkaaren hallinnasta, DevOps-toimintatavoista ja ympäristöjen hallinnasta.
Kokemusta yritysratkaisujen integraatioarkkitehtuureista ja järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden suunnittelusta.
Kyky määritellä tietoturvaan, käyttöoikeuksiin, tietosuojaan ja hallintamalleihin liittyviä ratkaisuja.
Kokemusta tekoäly- ja automaatioratkaisujen hyödyntämisestä osana laajempia liiketoimintaratkaisuja.
Ymmärrys käyttäjäkeskeisestä suunnittelusta ja kyky huomioida loppukäyttäjän tarpeet ratkaisujen suunnittelussa.
Erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaidot sekä kyky kommunikoida teknisiä ratkaisuja erilaisille kohderyhmille.
Käytännön kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja modernien kehitysvälineiden hyödyntämisestä.

Teknologiat ja menetelmät

Microsoft Power Platform
Service Bus
Dataverse
API-ratkaisut

PCF-komponentit

LLM-rajapinnat
Copilot Studio
Vektoritietokannat
Azure
ALM ja ympäristöstrategia

DLP, tietoturva ja käyttöoikeuksien hallinta
Azure Logic Apps
Conversational design ja AI-agenttien ratkaisumallit

Tarjoamme sinulle

Uramahdollisuuksia ja kehittymistä: osana tiimiämme pääset kehittämään osaamistasi jatkuvasti ja pysymään älykkään automaation alan kehityksen kärjessä.
Merkityksellisiä projekteja: projektimme luovat todellista vaikutusta. Autamme suurimpia yrityksiä hyödyntämään dataa tehokkaammin, ja sinulla on mahdollisuus olla mukana kehittämässä kokonaisia liiketoiminta-alueita.
Huippuosaajien tiimin: voimme ylpeänä sanoa rakentaneemme poikkeuksellisen vahvan asiantuntijayhteisön, jossa jokaisen osaaminen täydentää toisiaan ja yhdessä saavutamme enemmän.
Joustavat työskentelytavat: tarjoamme joustavuutta työn tekemiseen juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla. Työskentelemme joustavalla hybridityömallilla.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Portfolio Analysis
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp's Product Division, a full-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5-7 people in the Portfolio Analysis Product Area. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product and on capabilities used by investment professionals to understand portfolios, performance and risk.

In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.

AI is one of the modern practices we take seriously. We do not view AI as a separate area of engineering. We view it as another tool in the engineering toolbox. Just as we continuously adopted better testing, automation and cloud technologies, we expect AI to become a natural part of how we design, build, document, test, maintain and improve software.

Benefits

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we may ask you to provide feedback, which is highly appreciated.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
to join our Innovation team. The role embeds with enterprise clients remotely, with onsite visits as engagements require.

Position Summary

Reporting to the VP, Innovation, Solution Delivery, the Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) embeds with enterprise clients to design, build and operationalize agentic AI solutions in production. You will build production outcomes for clients, integrate agentic systems with enterprise platforms and systems of record, and stay accountable through cutover, early production and handover to ongoing support. The role is platform-agnostic by design and adapts to whichever AI platform best fits the client, including hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery, scope agentic AI use cases, and translate business problems into engineering deliverables with measurable success criteria such as cycle-time reduction, support deflection, automation rate, security and governance success rate and adoption rate.
Design target architectures that fit the client's environment, regulatory posture and platform preferences, selecting the right substrate per engagement across hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.
Write production-grade code to deliver the solution, working inside the client's source control, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure, and within enterprise release governance including change approvals, separation of duties, audit evidence and rollback planning.
Build and tune retrieval pipelines, prompt architecture, guardrails, agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls that hold under real production variation.
Implement enterprise-safe agent tool execution, including permission scoping, approval gates, audit trails and rollback paths for any agent action that touches systems of record.
Build evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions, grounding gaps and quality drift, and implement production observability for latency, token usage, error rates, accuracy and output drift.
Integrate solutions with client identity, secrets management, network controls, incident response and compliance tooling.
Stay engaged through cutover and the first production iteration cycle, then run a structured handover to the ongoing support team, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
Act as an escalation backup to the support team after handover, stepping back in when issues exceed the support team's depth or when the system needs architectural intervention.
Build trusted advisor relationships with client engineering, data, security and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly to both engineering teams and C-level audiences.
Abstract field learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that feed back into Innovation and shape product direction, methodology and the next engagement.

Experience

This is a Principal-level role. We are looking for engineers with the depth to operate independently inside enterprise client environments, the breadth to span production engineering and applied AI, and the demonstrated ability to ship in a discipline that is still being defined. We weight recent, hands-on agentic AI work heavily, recognising that production agentic systems are a young discipline. Equivalent experience from adjacent disciplines, including machine learning engineering, applied AI research with production deployment exposure, or senior backend engineering with recent agentic shipping, is welcomed.

8+ years of professional engineering experience across production systems, with significant production rather than purely advisory time.
2+ years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production, with demonstrated hands-on agentic or LLM-based work.
Proven track record working directly with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 enterprise clients in ambiguous, complex environments.
Track record of operating across the full lifecycle of a system, including architecture ownership, handover to support and ongoing escalation support.
Demonstrated ability to learn fast and ship in emerging technical disciplines. Candidates whose recent agentic AI work was learned quickly on the back of strong fundamentals are explicitly in scope.
Enterprise systems-of-record grounding: hands-on experience with an ERP we support (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards), or strong business-process depth in core enterprise processes such as procurement, finance and order-to-cash. Direct SAP or Oracle E-Business Suite experience preferred.

Skills

ERP and enterprise systems experience across SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, infor, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday or other systems of record. Direct SAP and Oracle EBS experience highly valued. Required for ERP-anchored regional seats.
Experience with multiple agentic AI platforms, demonstrating ability to deliver on whichever platform the client has standardized on.
Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or equivalent embedded delivery role at an AI lab, hyperscaler or systems integrator.
Production Python and at least one additional enterprise or full-stack language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, C# or Scala, including modern agent frameworks and patterns.
SQL and data modelling fluency, including the ability to reason about enterprise data quality, lineage, permissions and operational semantics.
Hands-on retrieval-augmented generation, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores and reranking.
Evaluation suite design for LLM-based systems, including regression detection, hallucination measurement and grounding checks.
Production observability for AI systems, including latency, token usage, error rate and output drift instrumentation.
Working knowledge of at least one major agentic AI platform such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, ServiceNow AI and willingness to learn others as engagements demand.
Agent tool execution and governance, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool interfaces, permission scoping, scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails and safe execution controls.
Enterprise integration fundamentals, including REST and event-driven patterns, identity flows such as OIDC and SAML, and secure deployment into client-controlled environments.
UI and front-end fluency in modern web frameworks such as Angular, React or equivalent, sufficient to build or extend the user-facing layer of agentic solutions.
Durable execution frameworks, event-driven architectures or workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
Exceptional written and verbal communication across deep technical and executive audiences, with strong consultative and outcomes-driven instincts. High autonomy, resilience and pragmatism in legacy and politically complex environments, with the proactive discipline needed for effective remote embedding.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location

Remote - Singapore

Travel

Region-specific (see regional variants of this role). Travel typically 25 percent to work with clients, prospects, partners or attend events.

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

Company
We dream big and innovate boldly.

Colleagues

to lead the design and evolution of scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions. Define and own the architecture of .NET-based applications, platforms, APIs, and distributed systems.

Establish architectural standards, principles, patterns, and best practices across development teams.

Provide technical guidance and architectural direction throughout the software development lifecycle.
Design and oversee RESTful APIs, microservices, integrations, and distributed systems.

Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, scalability challenges, and opportunities for modernization and optimization.

Support development teams with architecture reviews, technical discussions, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

8+ years of experience in software development, with strong experience in the .NET ecosystem and proven experience in a Software Architect or similar senior technical role.
Strong proficiency in C# and modern .NET
, including .NET Core / .NET 6+ and ASP.NET Core.

.

Solid understanding of cloud architecture, preferably Microsoft Azure

Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
is a plus.
Strong understanding of security, scalability, availability, resilience, observability, and performance considerations in enterprise applications.
Experience with CI/CD, Git, and modern software delivery practices.
Ability to assess existing architectures, identify technical debt, and define pragmatic modernization strategies.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make and communicate sound architectural decision
