. In deze functie werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, modernisering en verdere uitbouw van onze interne softwareoplossingen en het achterliggende servicelandschap.

Je Bent Verantwoordelijk Voor

Het zelfstandig meewerken aan verschillende softwareprojecten, in nauwe samenwerking met andere developers, functionele analisten en de application architect.
Het vertalen van functionele en business requirements naar technische oplossingen, en het actief meedenken over een passende en pragmatische technische aanpak.
Het ontwikkelen, testen en onderhouden van backendservices en REST API's binnen een microservicearchitectuur.
Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe toepassingen en services, maar ook het moderniseren en verder uitbouwen van bestaande oplossingen.
Het werken met zowel synchrone als asynchrone communicatie tussen services, onder andere via REST API's en messaging.
Het schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en consistente code volgens de afgesproken development- en architectuurconventies.
Het actief deelnemen aan code reviews en mee bewaken van de kwaliteit van de codebase.
Het helpen verbeteren van onze development lifecycle, technische standaarden en development guidelines.
Het actief opvolgen van relevante evoluties binnen het .NET-ecosysteem en samen met het team beoordelen waar nieuwe technologie een meerwaarde kan bieden.

In deze functie verwachten we dat je zelfstandig kan werken, initiatief neemt en actief meedenkt over technische keuzes. Je werkt binnen een team van developers en analisten en kan technische beslissingen duidelijk onderbouwen en bespreken.

Opleiding en ervaring – Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma Informatica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als backend developer en een sterke interesse in softwareontwikkeling en softwarekwaliteit.
Analyse – Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je kan complexe problemen structureren, pragmatische oplossingen uitwerken en technische keuzes onderbouwen.
Zelfstandigheid en samenwerking – Je kan zelfstandig taken opnemen en prioriteiten bewaken, maar werkt tegelijk graag samen met andere developers, analisten en architecten. Je communiceert duidelijk over technische keuzes, problemen en mogelijke oplossingen.
Can do – Je bent leergierig, communiceert vlot en kan zelfstandig prioriteiten stellen.
Kwaliteitsgericht werken – Je hecht belang aan leesbare en onderhoudbare code, geautomatiseerde tests, consistente ontwikkelstandaarden en degelijke code reviews.
Talenkennis – Je beheerst vlot de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Kennis van Frans is een pluspunt.

Technische kennis

Je Hebt Hands-on Ervaring Met

C# en modern .NET, bij voorkeur .NET 8 of recenter
Het ontwikkelen van REST API's met ASP.NET Core
Entity Framework Core en relationele databases, bij voorkeur SQL Server
Asynchroon programmeren
Dependency injection en gangbare .NET-ontwikkelpatronen
Git en een professionele development workflow met branches, pull requests en code reviews.

Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande technologieën of concepten is een sterke meerwaarde:

Microservice architectuur
CQRS en event-driven architectuur
Asynchronous messaging, bijvoorbeeld met MassTransit en RabbitMQ
NoSQL databases
Minimal APIs en API-versioning
EF Core
JWT-gebaseerde authenticatie en autorisatie
Automated testing met bijvoorbeeld xUnit en Moq

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

We are seeking a highly consultative Staff Solutions Architect
to support our most important customers. This role is a critical technical position, spanning both product development and pre and post sales customer motions.

You will act as a trusted technical lead and thought leader, partnering closely with Account Executives, Post Sales, and Product teams to drive measurable business and technical value through

High priority customer technical leadership
Docker field technical leadership

This role reports to the Director of Solutions Architecture and operates at the intersection of technical depth, business acumen, and thought leadership.

Responsibilities

High priority customer technical leadership

Work with Docker’s most important customers and cross functional Docker teams to accelerate the customer’s container and AI journeys, focusing on developer workflows
Engage with customer teams and cross functional Docker teams to gather customer’s technical/business goals and challenges related to their container and AI journey.
Create and manage engagement plans that span existing products and new Docker offerings to achieve critical business goals.
Oversee “design partner” rapid prototyping engagements with Docker engineering and customer teams to validate customer-product fit for new use cases
Work with Docker teams to create/manage/deliver custom demos and content aligned to customer use cases.
Deliver high-impact enablement and best practices content to customer audiences from developer to C level.
Ability to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

Docker field technical leadership (regional/area of responsibility)

Be a thought leader for a particular area of responsibility both internal and external to Docker, working with fellow Dockhands to create/manage/deliver content
Gather field feedback from customer teams and Docker pre and post sales teams
Coordinate with Field CTO and other Solutions Architects to prioritize/contextualize/correlate field requests into a cohesive set of prioritized requests to the product/engineering teams.
Work directly with Docker product/engineering teams on workflows and feature alignment to customer use cases prioritized by revenue impact.
Be customer zero for new functionality produced by Docker product/engineering teams
Give input on internal technical enablement and customer enablement needs, and review enablement content
Assist the sales enablement team with internal technical enablement for new products and services.

Qualifications

Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solution Architect in complex enterprise environments.
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing customer relationships at the technical and business level.
Experience presenting solutions and demonstrations to small and large audiences, virtually and in person.
Experience interfacing with internal product/software teams, including technical support, product, and engineering, to enhance documentation, enablement, and product features to improve customer experience and enablement.
Experience developing application code, and a clear understanding of the challenges developers experience on a daily basis.
Ability to solve technical problems and translate customer experience to actionable feedback for engineering.
Experience developing collateral to assist customers with best-practice adoption.
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containers, DevOps, and modern application architectures.
Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies strongly preferred.
Development, Agentic AI dev, Software Development Lifecycle and/or Software Supply Chain Security experience strongly preferred.
Must be fluent in English
Willingness to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

What to expect

First 30 days

You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program
You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as; Salesforce, Outreach, Sigma, and Opine.
Actively engage with senior stakeholders, and manage relationships with clients
You will work closely with your peers and shadow customer meetings to develop strategies to advocate for our customers.
At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role.

First 60 days

You will be laser-focused on supporting the sales and customer success teams during your second month.
You will have connected with all of your team members.
You will gain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and how they impact our customers.
You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in your role.

First 90 days

In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to immerse yourself in our customer’s business needs fully.
You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and activities.
Educate our clients about our product roadmap and undertake product training for users
You will be ready to operate independently at full speed.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

EU:
€141,400K – €202K + equity

AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

new_jobs.description:
Req ID: FEQ327R409

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to have

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.
Depth in an industry vertical (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, and others).

new_jobs.title: Software Security Engineer*
new_jobs.description:
Das erwartet dich bei uns:

Du arbeitest in Beratungs- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten bei Kunden wie AXA, BMW, der Deutschen Bahn und ZDF
Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst Softwarelösungen, in dem du AI-Methoden und Tools im gesamten Softwareentwicklungsprozess anwendest (z.B. LLMs, agentische Frameworks, Codegenerierung und Testautomatisierung)
Du verfügst über Erfahrung und Expertise in der sicheren Software Entwicklung, um Best Principles und Practices für sichere Softwareentwicklung, z. B. NCSC, OWASP oder Mitre, in den Projekten einzusetzen und an uns anzupassen
Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien wie C#, Java, JavaScript, Spring oder Vue – je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen bringst du einen Teil davon in unsere Projekte ein und bist verantwortlich für die IT-Sicherheit
Du entwirfst und baust sichere Infrastrukturen in der Cloud (z. B. AWS, Azure, IONOS, Google) für die von uns entwickelten Anwendungen

Das zeichnet dich aus:

Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder in einer vergleichbaren Disziplin erfolgreich abgeschlossen
Du bringst tiefgehende, praktische Kenntnisse im Software Engineering mit und fühlst dich sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend wohl
Du beherrscht Secure by Design, Zero Trust und andere Prinzipien der IT-Sicherheit hast diese bereits erfolgreich in komplexen und anspruchvollen Projekten eingebracht
Du verfügst über Wissen zu den OWASP Top 10 und Mitre CWE Top 25, wendest diese Praktiken an und vermeidest entsprechende Risiken.
Du besitzt Erfahrungen mit Automatisierung im Sinne von DevOps und die Integration von Sicherheitstools (SAST, SCA, IAST, DAST) damit
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und trägst aktiv zum Erfolg deines Projektteams bei
Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1 Level) und sehr gut Englisch (mindestens B2)

Unser Angebot an dich:

Wertschätzung & Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr
Fachlicher Austausch & Wissenstransfer: 14 interne Communities & Netzwerke (z. B. ML, Green IT, Architektur, IoT)
Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice-Anteil
Jobrad, Workation, Sabbatical, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss, Gesundheitsprogramme und vieles mehr
Faires Gehaltsmodell: Finale Vergütung richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikation und bisherigen Erfahrung

Das ist Accso:

Accso ist Digitalpartner für anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen nach Maß – mit AI Native Mindset
. Wir verbinden exzellentes Engineering und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit pragmatischem KI-Einsatz, von der Konzeption über die Entwicklung bis hin zum Betrieb. Uns treibt eine klare Vision: die Welt ein Stück besser machen
, indem wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zukunftssichere Softwareentwicklung und messbaren Impact schaffen. Dabei steht der Mensch im Fokus
– bei unseren Kunden genauso wie in unseren Teams. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, lösungsorientiert, exzellenzgetrieben, mit offener Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. In interdisziplinären Teams bringst du dich direkt beim Kunden ein – mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, aktivem Wissenstransfer und einer Kultur, die Neugier, Verantwortung und Lernen fördert. Bei uns kannst du dich einbringen, wie du bist, moderne Technologien verantwortungsbewusst einsetzen und dich fachlich wie persönlich stetig weiterentwickeln. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine Bewerbung:

Es ist uns nicht so wichtig, dass du die Stellenanforderungen zu 100% erfüllst, sondern dass du unser Team mit deinen Talenten, deinem Wissen und deiner Art bereicherst und wir gemeinsam wachsen.

Für uns ist dein Talent entscheidend, nicht dein Geschlecht, deine Herkunft, Glaubensrichtung, sexuelle Orientierung oder eine eventuelle Behinderung.

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Entwickler:in (d/m/w) - Prozessautomatisierung
new_jobs.description:
Werde Teil von einem Lexware
Team, welches 450.000+ Klein- und Kleinstunternehmen in Deutschland den Rücken frei hält. Als versierte:r Senior Full Stack Entwickler:in (d/m/w)
mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung übernimmst du die Schlüsselrolle in der Skalierung unseres Produkts.

Dafür liegt dein fachlicher Fokus auf neuen Flows und Prozessen, die es unseren Kund:innen noch einfacher machen, ihre Aufträge abzuwickeln und stets den Überblick zu behalten. Dein Vorgehen? Bestehende Ansätze hinterfragen und neue Wege finden. Das machst du nicht alleine, sondern mit einem neu entstehenden Team. Der gemeinsame Nordstern: Begeisterte Kund:innen und eine reibungslose Einkaufs- und Verkaufs Journey!

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle
sind bei uns selbstverständlich – du kannst gerne von zu Hause arbeiten und gleichzeitig freuen wir uns, dich an unseren Teamtagen (Di. und Do.) im Büro in Freiburg im Breisgau
begrüßen zu dürfen.

Das Erwartet Dich

Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten. Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Anforderungen vorgegeben werden, stattdessen hilfst du, sie gemeinsam zu definieren. In Discovery-Phasen, Delivery-Momenten und den Etappenzielen dazwischen ist deine Seniorität gefragt
Tech-Stack & Architektur: Du arbeitest in einer modernen Microservice-Architektur und stellst die reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen den Services sicher. Mit deinem Team entscheidest du über den Einsatz neuer Tools und Ansätze, die es braucht, damit Skalierung tatsächlich möglich wird.
Agentic AI & Future Work: Wir begreifen KI nicht nur als Werkzeug, sondern als Motor für einen fundamentalen Wachstumsschritt. Du gestaltest diesen Wandel aktiv mit und hilfst uns, KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows tief in unsere Produktstrukturen zu integrieren. Übrigen gibt es bei uns den frAIday. Was dahinter steckt, erzählen wir dir gerne persönlich. Interesse geweckt?

Das Bringst Du Mit

Full Stack@Heart: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bau moderner Backend-Systeme mit Spring Boot und Java. Erfahrung mit React, TypeScript und Material UI runden dein breit aufgebautes Profil ab
Daten, Cloud & AI: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in relationalen Datenbanken (vorzugsweise PostgreSQL) mit und bewegst dich sicher in der AWS-Welt. Deine Erfahrungen im Datenbankdesign und den damit notwendigen Optimierungen oder Migrationen, nimmst du als spannende Projekte wahr. Idealerweise bist du bereits mit AI-Native Engineering vertraut und kannst auf Erfahrungen zurückblicken
Brücken bauen: Für diese Position suchen wir bewusst eine sehr erfahrene Persönlichkeit mit hoher Kommunikationskompetenz: Dir gelingt es, die Brücken zwischen Entwicklung, Produkt, UX und weiteren Disziplinen zu schlagen und ein gewinnbringendes Zusammenspiel zu fördern
Kommunikation: Unsere Teamsprache ist Deutsch, daher sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C2) ein Muss

Bei uns trifft der jüngste Podcast-Tipp in der Kaffeeküche auf den nächsten Pass auf dem Platz. Ob wir gemeinsam beim SC Freiburg mitfiebern, die Trails mit dem Rad erobern oder eine ruhige Partie Schach spielen, wir teilen die Leidenschaft für Bewegung und Köpfchen. Und weil so viel Energie bekanntlich hungrig macht, sichern wir uns den besten Platz in der Mittagspause, am liebsten schon vor 12 Uhr. Wenn du Lust auf echten Teamgeist, frische Impulse und gemeinsame Erfolge hast, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Denn diesen Vibe spürst du bei uns ab der ersten Sekunde: Da wir unser Recruiting komplett selbst in die Hand nehmen, lernst du uns direkt und ungeschminkt kennen. Wir suchen jemanden, der als unser Sparringspartner den nächsten Aufstieg genauso sicher begleitet wie eine steile Trail-Abfahrt. Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die Bock hat, gemeinsam mit uns die Zielgruppe der Klein- und Kleinstunternehmen mit begeisterter Software zum Strahlen zu bringen.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
new_jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you’ll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, You’ll

Work with a cross-functional team. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features.
Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you’ll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
Mentor. You’ll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
User-focused. You’re excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

Role Context

The British Council builds connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and other countries through arts and culture, education, and the English language. We work in two ways - directly with individuals to transform their lives, and with governments and partners to make a bigger difference for the longer term, creating benefit for millions of people all over the world. We help young people to gain the skills, confidence, and connections they are looking for to realise their potential and to participate in strong and inclusive communities. We support them to learn English, to get a high-quality education and to gain internationally recognised qualifications. Our work in arts and culture stimulates creative expression and exchange and nurtures creative enterprise. We connect the best of the UK with the world and the best of the world with the UK.

The role sits as part of the Data Evidence and Performance (DEP) team, which is part of the Global Operations function and includes the central oversight and leadership for corporate planning, performance management, evaluation and reporting, the management of strategic risk and of investment, internal audit, shared services, marketing, digital and technology. DEP provides the central leadership and development for the British Council’s Data Analytics and Evidence Strategy working across the organisation with stakeholders to leverage our Data and Evidence assets. This includes driving better data quality through enterprise data governance, designing and delivering data technology and insight solutions, co-ordinating an organisational community of practice for Data Analytics and Evidence, development of the British Council KPIs framework, monitoring and reviewing performance to drive improvement, evaluation, and measurement of impact to help improve decision making.

Role Purpose

The Associate AI Engineer is part of the Data Science and Analytics team, helping to establish and build the British Council enterprise approach to Data Evidence and Performance. The role is responsible for developing, implementing, deploying and maintaining AI-enabled applications and services, working with data scientists, data engineers and Digital and Technology colleagues. The postholder applies good software engineering, cloud, security and responsible AI practices to deliver reliable, user-centred solutions, while continuing to build their technical capability.

Main Accountabilities

Function Support and Service Improvement

AI Application Development

Work with the Data Scientist and cross-functional teams to develop AI-enabled applications and services, including working closely with data engineering and Digital and Technology teams.
Develop user-facing and backend components using appropriate technologies, including Microsoft Power Apps where suitable and Python or JavaScript-based services where pro-code is required.
Use Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning and other Azure AI services to build and integrate AI capabilities.
Build, test and evaluate AI and generative AI components, including prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic or vector search and agent-based patterns where appropriate.

Application Deployment And Support

Deploy AI applications and models to internal customers, ensuring effective integration, reliability, security and functionality.
Monitor and troubleshoot developed applications and services, resolving faults and supporting continuous improvement.
Apply British Council requirements for information security, data protection, accessibility and responsible AI, including appropriate testing and controls for AI-specific risks.

Agile Development

Work in an agile development environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
Own defined work packages, prioritise tasks with the team and deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines.

Relationship and Stakeholder Management

Support the development of customer-centric and insight-led working.
Collaborate with team members, stakeholders and subject matter experts to understand user and business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs clearly.

Leadership and management (self-development)

Complete British Council induction, mandatory training and role-related learning.
Keep technical knowledge current across AI, software engineering and cloud technologies, applying learning to practical delivery.
Seek feedback and mentoring, contribute to code reviews and knowledge sharing, and take responsibility for continuous professional development

Minimum/essential

Requirements of the role

Degree-level qualification or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline.
Applied AI engineering. Practical experience, gained through employment, internship, academic work or substantial projects, of building AI or machine learning applications.
Programming and software engineering. Proficiency in Python and experience with APIs, JSON, Git/version control and testing. Familiarity with SQL and software development practices.
Generative AI and machine learning. Practical understanding of large language models and common patterns such as prompt engineering, embeddings or vector search, RAG and agentic workflows, plus familiarity with at least one machine learning or AI framework or SDK.
Cloud and deployment. Practical exposure to Azure or another major cloud platform for developing or deploying applications, with an understanding of CI/CD, containers and monitoring concepts.
Responsible delivery and collaboration. Understanding of information security, data protection and responsible AI risks, and the ability to work in an agile, multidisciplinary team and communicate technical issues clearly

Desirable

Microsoft AI stack. Experience with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning or related Azure AI services.
AI engineering tools. Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and with vector databases or semantic search.
Full-stack delivery. Exposure to Docker, CI/CD, REST APIs and frontend or low-code development such as JavaScript/TypeScript or Microsoft Power Apps.

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. new_jobs.title: Engineering, Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

Today, EF English Live does not consistently apply appropriate QA coverage to relevant Salesforce and Web tickets before release. Volume has outpaced our current QA capacity, so coverage gaps happen, and where testing does happen it often leans towards happy-path checks rather than risk-based regression testing. We already use AIO for automation and want to build on it further, and more hands are needed to close the coverage gap in the meantime.

This role is about adding real capacity: hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, with risk-based coverage applied according to the nature and impact of each change, plus active support extending and complementing our existing AIO automation. Our existing QA lead will continue to own and drive the automation strategy; this hire works alongside them, splitting time between hands-on testing and helping extend that automation over time.

Role Overview

This is a fixed-term contract engagement, initially for 4 to 6 months. The Senior QA Automation Engineer will provide thorough, hands-on testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based coverage according to the nature and impact of each change, while also helping extend and complement our existing AIO automation. This is a genuinely hybrid role: meaningful hands-on testing capacity now, and a growing share of automation work over time , done in close partnership with our existing QA lead rather than in place of them.

Within 3 Months, Success Looks Like

All relevant Salesforce and Web tickets receiving appropriate QA coverage before release, with risk-based testing applied according to the nature and impact of the change.
Regression testing meaningfully expanded beyond happy-path checks.
Our existing AIO automation extended and complemented, with additional tooling or approaches identified where they would provide better coverage or maintainability.
The existing QA lead measurably better supported, with more capacity across the team rather than the load resting on one person.

Main Responsibilities

Hands-On QA Coverage (Salesforce & Web)

Provide thorough manual and exploratory testing across relevant Salesforce and Web tickets, applying risk-based testing according to the nature and impact of each change.
Prioritise regression testing, not just happy-path checks, to reduce the risk of shipping undetected issues.

Test Automation & Tooling

Extend and complement our existing AIO automation, identifying where additional tooling or approaches would provide better coverage or maintainability.
Work alongside the existing QA lead, who owns the overall automation strategy and roadmap, contributing hands-on automation build where needed.

Collaboration & Capability Building

Work alongside the existing QA lead and engineering team to raise the overall QA bar, across both tooling and process.
Partner with Business Systems and engineering leads to prioritise coverage based on commercial risk.

Reporting

Report to Business Systems Engineering leadership, with visibility on release risk and quality metrics shared with the wider team.

Technical Background & Skills

Core Experience

Strong hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience across web applications and, ideally, CRM/Salesforce environments.
Experience in automating tests using Javascript /Typescript frameworks (e.g. Nightwatch.js, Cypress, Playwright)
Experience with API and integration testing, including validating data flows between Salesforce, web applications and third-party systems.
Comfortable splitting time between hands-on ticket testing and automation work, rather than being purely one or the other.

Ways of Working

Genuinely hybrid: as comfortable manually testing a ticket as contributing to an automation framework.
Collaborative: complements and supports the existing QA lead's automation strategy rather than working around it.
Pragmatic about what to automate first, while making sure day-to-day coverage across Salesforce and Web doesn't slip in the meantime.

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

The team

The Fungible team is the “rapid-response squad” within the Field Engineering organisation that engages with customers on the most strategic, highest-potential opportunities across Benelux and the Nordics to accelerate critical use cases, land technical wins, and drive successful Databricks adoption. If you enjoy working on novel use cases across a variety of industries on highly visible engagements, this is the right home for you!

The role

As a Fungible Solutions Architect, you lead the technical strategy on time-boxed, targeted engagements
- typically one to five months - aimed at accelerating a specific set of critical customer workloads from evaluation to a production-grade technical win. You own the architecture conversation, drive platform adoption, and act as a trusted advisor to customer architects and engineering leaders, then transition the momentum you've built to the core account team.

You bring technical depth and the judgment to apply it fast, in situations that require strong ownership
and are highly visible
. Where a specialisation helps you contribute quickly, great — but on this team, breadth, adaptability, and a bias for impact matter just as much as your area of depth.

The impact you will have

Accelerate what matters most: parachute into strategic, high-profile opportunities and own a clearly defined technical area, moving critical workloads and use cases from evaluation toward production and consumption.
Lead the architecture: design scalable, production-grade solutions across data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics, and lead the whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off decisions with senior customer stakeholders.
Win the technical decision: demonstrate Databricks' differentiation through custom-built solutions in competitive, must-win scenarios.
Move fast while maintaining the bar: establish momentum quickly in ambiguous situations and compress timelines without cutting corners.
Hand off, don't hold on: package your progress into a clean transition to core SAs, DSAs, specialists, or partners so wins are sustained and expanded after you move to the next engagement.
Scale: bring back patterns, plays, and product feedback that make every engagement after yours faster.

What We Look For

We care more about how you think and the impact you've had than about a specific checklist. You'll likely bring most of the following, and if you're missing one or two but bring something we haven't thought of, we still want to hear from you!

Several years of experience (typically ~6+) in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role, or a track record that demonstrates equivalent depth.
Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL, with the ability to build, debug, and demonstrate working solutions live.
Depth in distributed data systems and production cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), scalable pipelines, streaming, and lakehouse patterns, plus the infrastructure, security, and governance to run them.
Proficiency on the Databricks Platform, or a demonstrated ability to ramp on new technology quickly. A strong "spike" in an area such as real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, or migrations helps you add value fast.
Experience leading architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders, design reviews, trade-off analysis, clear recommendations, and translating complex architecture into business value for both engineers and executives.
The temperament this team runs on: comfort with ambiguity and time-boxed engagements, strong prioritisation, and a genuine preference for variety and high-impact work.

Nice to haves

Given our role in the Field Engineering organisation, we are always looking to expand the depth our team can offer with your areas of specialisation. Any of the following would be a valuable addition to the team!

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, or Platform).
Familiarity with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) and how to position against them.
Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Hydro Building Systems Sweden AB utvecklar och marknadsför system i aluminiumprofiler till tre affärsområden: Transportsystem, Golvsystem och Byggsystem. In your daily work you will, together with your team, understand and review customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C#, Dyalog APL and Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend components, APIs and services.

The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping parts of our product for the cloud. We are not modernizing for the sake of fashion. We are doing it because our products are business critical, widely used and need to keep evolving in a careful way.

AI Is Part Of How We Work Every Day

We use AI every day and see it as a natural part of modern software engineering, alongside source control, testing, CI/CD and code reviews. We actively look for ways to integrate AI into our work whenever it creates real benefit for our customers, products, teams or engineers. AI does not replace engineering judgment. It helps good engineers learn faster, reduce repetitive work, explore alternatives and build better software.

In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team and individual.

We encourage personal development, curiosity and experimentation. Every sixth sprint is reserved for planning, innovation, learning and improvements, giving you regular opportunities to explore new technologies, improve something important, or try out ideas that may benefit you, your team or the application.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We are looking for a developer who enjoys real product engineering: understanding the problem, discussing trade-offs, writing good software, ensuring quality and improving the system over time.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to help lead beyond writing code. You will contribute to design discussions, help the team make good technical decisions, improve maintainability and performance, and support the software you help build.

Designing, developing and maintaining backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET
Working with Dyalog APL and other technologies where they are part of the product
Contributing to cloud modernization and scalable service design where it adds real value
Improving performance, maintainability, testability and developer experience
Using CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews as natural parts of daily engineering work
Using AI every day as part of practical engineering work, including exploring ideas, understanding unfamiliar code, generating prototypes, improving tests, documenting decisions and automating routine tasks
Working with the team to discover where AI can create real value in our development process and where human engineering judgment should lead
Collaborating with product owners, domain experts and fellow engineers to turn customer needs into good software solutions
Supporting the team in continuously improving both the product and the way we work

What We Expect From You

We expect you to know some of the following and be able to, and interested in, learning the rest:

C# and .NET development
Backend development and API design
Building high-performance, scalable and maintainable applications
Continuous integration and delivery
Automated testing and practical quality engineering
Working with relational databases, such as Oracle or similar
Cloud technologies, distributed systems or Azure-based services
A willingness to learn additional technologies, including Dyalog APL
Curiosity about AI-assisted software engineering and how it can improve daily development work

Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What We Value

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important than your ability to learn, collaborate, and handle responsibilities.

We value people who are good at several of the following and interested in improving the rest:

Leading your work and achieving results
Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
Working with others to leverage the abilities of everyone in the team
Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
Looking continuously for ways to improve what we do and how we do it
Comparing technical quality with business value
Using modern tools, especially AI tools, every day where they help us build better software and become better engineers
Contributing to an inclusive, trust-based and collaborative engineering culture

How We Work

We believe good software engineering is a team activity. Quality is not something handed over at the end. It is built into the way we discuss requirements, design solutions, write code, test, review, deploy and learn from production feedback.

We also believe senior engineers should have room to think. We do not expect you to chase every trend. We expect you to apply sound engineering judgment, use modern practices where they help, and help us evolve a large and widely used product in a way that is sustainable for clients, users and engineers.

AI is one of the modern practices we take seriously. We do not view AI as a separate area of engineering. We view it as another tool in the engineering toolbox. Just as we continuously adopted better testing, automation and cloud technologies, we expect AI to become a natural part of how we design, build, document, test, maintain and improve software.

Benefits

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible. We process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for helping us mitigate bias in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we may ask you to provide feedback, which is highly appreciated.

What you will do

Develop across the stack: .NET 10 and Entity Framework on the back end, Angular 21 on the front end, Azure SQL Database for persistence.

Contribute to the management of our Azure environment and to infrastructure defined as code with Terraform.
Maintain technical documentation: architecture decisions, runbooks and onboarding material.
Work in an agile environment, collaborating with product, data science and design.

How we work

AI tools support our developers in their day-to-day work and are integrated into how we build software. Keeping that setup growing is part of the team’s work and part of this role. If you are excited about AI and where it is heading, you will have room to run with it.

What you bring

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
Substantial professional experience building and operating production web applications end to end (typically 5+ years)
Strong .NET and Entity Framework skills, with solid SQL Server experience
Extensive Angular experience
Proficiency with Git and a pull-request-based workflow
Demonstrated command of clean code, SOLID principles and testing methodology, with the ability to explain why, not only apply the rule
Experience working with AI coding agents and reviewing their output
Fluent English and Spanish

Nice to have

Multi-tenant SaaS architecture and tenant isolation experience
Infrastructure as code (Terraform) and hands-on Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Redis)

A product-oriented mindset and experience working closely with Product Owners

Tech stack

.NET 10 · Entity Framework · Angular 21 · Azure SQL Database · Azure (App Service, Managed Redis, Azure OpenAI, Key Vault, Storage) · Terraform · Playwright and xUnit · Azure DevOps · Claude Code

What we offer

Full-time contract in a growing, international scale-up
Fully remote within Spain or hybrid in Santander or Barcelona, whichever suits you
Flexible hours, Fridays until 3 pm and reduced summer hours
25 holidays plus 2 additional Personal Time Off days

Career Path & Learning budget
Cobee & Wellhub

We are looking for a Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of AI engineering and customer success. Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) and prompt engineering basics

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

We are seeking a highly consultative Staff Solutions Architect
to support our most important customers. This role is a critical technical position, spanning both product development and pre and post sales customer motions.

You will act as a trusted technical lead and thought leader, partnering closely with Account Executives, Post Sales, and Product teams to drive measurable business and technical value through

High priority customer technical leadership
Docker field technical leadership

This role reports to the Director of Solutions Architecture and operates at the intersection of technical depth, business acumen, and thought leadership.

Responsibilities

High priority customer technical leadership

Work with Docker’s most important customers and cross functional Docker teams to accelerate the customer’s container and AI journeys, focusing on developer workflows
Engage with customer teams and cross functional Docker teams to gather customer’s technical/business goals and challenges related to their container and AI journey.
Create and manage engagement plans that span existing products and new Docker offerings to achieve critical business goals.
Oversee “design partner” rapid prototyping engagements with Docker engineering and customer teams to validate customer-product fit for new use cases
Work with Docker teams to create/manage/deliver custom demos and content aligned to customer use cases.
Deliver high-impact enablement and best practices content to customer audiences from developer to C level.
Ability to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

Docker field technical leadership (regional/area of responsibility)

Be a thought leader for a particular area of responsibility both internal and external to Docker, working with fellow Dockhands to create/manage/deliver content
Gather field feedback from customer teams and Docker pre and post sales teams
Coordinate with Field CTO and other Solutions Architects to prioritize/contextualize/correlate field requests into a cohesive set of prioritized requests to the product/engineering teams.
Work directly with Docker product/engineering teams on workflows and feature alignment to customer use cases prioritized by revenue impact.
Be customer zero for new functionality produced by Docker product/engineering teams
Give input on internal technical enablement and customer enablement needs, and review enablement content
Assist the sales enablement team with internal technical enablement for new products and services.

Qualifications

Proven experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solution Architect in complex enterprise environments.
Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience in managing customer relationships at the technical and business level.
Experience presenting solutions and demonstrations to small and large audiences, virtually and in person.
Experience interfacing with internal product/software teams, including technical support, product, and engineering, to enhance documentation, enablement, and product features to improve customer experience and enablement.
Experience developing application code, and a clear understanding of the challenges developers experience on a daily basis.
Ability to solve technical problems and translate customer experience to actionable feedback for engineering.
Experience developing collateral to assist customers with best-practice adoption.
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containers, DevOps, and modern application architectures.
Experience with Docker, container ecosystems, or adjacent technologies strongly preferred.
Development, Agentic AI dev, Software Development Lifecycle and/or Software Supply Chain Security experience strongly preferred.
Must be fluent in English
Willingness to travel up to 50% internationally as a senior representative of Docker to prospective clients, customers, and technical alliance partners.

What to expect

First 30 days

You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program
You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as; Salesforce, Outreach, Sigma, and Opine.
Actively engage with senior stakeholders, and manage relationships with clients
You will work closely with your peers and shadow customer meetings to develop strategies to advocate for our customers.
At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role.

First 60 days

You will be laser-focused on supporting the sales and customer success teams during your second month.
You will have connected with all of your team members.
You will gain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and how they impact our customers.
You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in your role.

First 90 days

In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to immerse yourself in our customer’s business needs fully.
You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and activities.
Educate our clients about our product roadmap and undertake product training for users
You will be ready to operate independently at full speed.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Compensation & Equity

EU:
€141,400K – €202K + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

new_jobs.description:
As an HMI and SCADA Software Engineer
at INNIO, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining modern HMI/SCADA software solutions, including both front-end and back-end components. You will work on secure, reliable, and maintainable systems, support customization through reusable templates and scripts, and collaborate with product management, end users, and validation teams to deliver high-quality solutions. In addition, you will provide troubleshooting and remote support for field systems, maintain technical documentation, and contribute within agile development processes such as SCRUM.

At INNIO We Offer You

Young & supportive team - in a fast-growing international business environment
Learn & develop yourself - help you craft your career path with (INNIO learning, free language courses according to business needs
Hybrid working - 50% Office, 50 % Home Office with flexible working hours
Cafeteria package with various options - SZÉP Card, Cash option, Nursery & kindergarten support
Medicover Spring White Package- from the first day of employment
Easily accessible location - in the heart of the most vibrant campus area in Budapest (location: 13rd District, easy to approach by Metro Line 3)
Take a break - Recharge your batteries with free coffee and tea selection in the kitchen area
Live an active lifestyle - activate your AYCM pass

Your Responsibilities

Design and develop front-end and back-end software components for INNIO HMI/SCADA systems using modern web technologies.
Architect highly available, secure, and maintainable software solutions.
Create reusable templates and scripts to streamline order-specific customizations and boost productivity.
Execute projects in alignment with the INNIO Jenbacher design process and agile methodologies (e.g., SCRUM).
Collaborate closely with product line management and end users to gather and analyze requirements.
Maintain and update software, providing timely field updates as needed.
Provide troubleshooting and third-level remote support for INNIO HMI/SCADA systems in the field.
Develop comprehensive technical documentation and user manuals.
Plan and conduct software validation activities in cooperation with validation engineers.

Your Profile

Bachelor or Masters degree in computing science, informatics, mechatronic or electrical engineering or equivalent
Fluent English and Hungarian communication skills (both written and spoken) German or any other language is a plus.
5+ years of experience and strong interest in WEB development (HTML 5, Type Script, Java Script, React or Angular JS) or .NET C#
Basic knowledge in Linux, Docker, CI/CD, agile development, GIT, Azure DevOps
Basic knowledge in SQL or Influx database design
